title: 郭凯算账：组合已够4.5%至5%，四季度不必再加码
speaker: Guo Kai

segments.en: I think if you look at what Chinese government have done in the past several months, they already tried to rule out some many stimulus.
segments.zh: 我认为如果你看看中国政府过去几个月的举措，他们已经尝试推出许多刺激措施。

segments.en: Like basically opening up the leftover quota, bond quotas for regional governments, which have physical effects. Exactly.
segments.zh: 比如基本上开放剩余额度，地方政府的债券额度，这具有实际效果。正是。

segments.en: That's 500 billion RMB, that's additional spending power, local governments can use.
segments.zh: 那是5000亿元人民币，这是地方政府可以使用的额外支出能力。

segments.en: The PBOC also lowered their lending to policy banks, that's called PSL, by 25 basis points.
segments.zh: 央行还将对政策性银行的贷款，即PSL，下调了25个基点。

segments.en: That would allow policy banks to lend more to projects at local level.
segments.zh: 这将允许政策性银行向地方项目提供更多贷款。

segments.en: They also actually wrote out some interest subsidy program for new home buyers that would help stabilize some housing demand.
segments.zh: 他们还实际推出了针对新购房者的利息补贴计划，有助于稳定部分住房需求。

segments.en: And you know, they didn't look big on its own, but we only have one quarter left for this year.
segments.zh: 你知道，它们单独看并不大，但今年我们只剩一个季度了。

segments.en: I think all this matter if we put together, plus actually there is another 800 billion new policy instruments will be deployed towards end of the year.
segments.zh: 我认为如果把这些放在一起，都很重要，另外还有8000亿元新政策工具将在年底前部署。

segments.en: If we add them together, that would be sufficient in my view to achieve this 4.5 to 5% growth.
segments.zh: 如果加在一起，在我看来足以实现4.5%至5%的增长。

segments.en: That's an interesting point, because we just got the GDP number at 4.5% in the third quarter which is basically at the bottom of the 4.5 to 5% range.
segments.zh: 这是一个有趣的观点，因为我们刚得到第三季度GDP为4.5%，基本处于4.5%至5%区间的底部。

segments.en: Does that mean no more stimulus is necessarily needed right now if they are focusing just on that target? And what does that mean for 2027?
segments.zh: 这是否意味着如果他们只关注那个目标，现在就不必再刺激了？这对2027年意味着什么？

segments.en: My sense is that if you look at Q3, actually the growth actually heads up compared to Q2. Q2 growth was only 4.3.
segments.zh: 我的感觉是，如果你看第三季度，增长实际上比第二季度有所回升。第二季度增长仅为4.3%。

segments.en: So actually there was marginal improvement in terms of growth momentum, but 5% in the first quarter. Yeah.
segments.zh: 所以实际上增长动能边际改善，但第一季度是5%。是的。

segments.en: Considering annual target is only 4.5 to 5%, and given that we only need 4.3, 4.4% growth in fourth quarter,
segments.zh: 考虑到年度目标仅为4.5%至5%，并且我们第四季度只需要4.3%、4.4%的增长，

segments.en: and given the policy of RSV announced in the past months also, I don't think there is big necessity to roll out additional stimulus for this year.
segments.zh: 再考虑到过去几个月宣布的政策，我认为今年没有太大必要推出额外刺激。
